alternation.reason: The question is whether removing the friction relay reduces steering oscillation (direction reversals per second) at 36-55 mph. Pass-to-pass variation is about 0.12 per second per pass of about 86 s; the one earlier comparison showed a drop of about 0.23 per second, about 1.9 times that variation.
alternation.minimum: About 4-5 passes per side (about 6-7 minutes per side) give 80 percent power for an effect of that size. It cannot show an effect as small as closed-loop replay predicted (about 0.05 per second): that would need well over an hour per side and is out of reach of any single drive.
alternation.buffer: 10 minutes per side is that minimum plus about half again, so a second drive is unlikely to be needed.
